global_style: Cinematic sci-fi with shallow depth of field, low slightly wide angle, high-key white light bloom, red-and-white palette, crisp mechanical device design, dramatic exposure blowout.

project_settings.location_lock: Abstract, indeterminate tech environment with blurred background—non-specific locale (NOT recognizable Earth city, NOT historical site, NOT natural landscape)
negative_constraints: Recognizable real-world cities, landmarks, skylines (e.g., Times Square, Eiffel Tower)
Historical architecture (cathedrals, temples, pagodas, castles, stone villages)
Religious iconography (crosses, halos, altars, stained glass)
Angelic or feathered wings (use crystal/mechanical only)
Medieval or fantasy elements (swords, armor, runes, magic circles)
Retro analog tech (CRT monitors, exposed cables, vacuum tubes)
Contemporary brand logos, text signage, or readable UI text
Lush natural scenery in clear focus (trees, mountains, oceans)
Space vistas or starfields; keep environment non-cosmic and abstract
Neon cyberpunk street scenes (wet asphalt, kanji signage, crowded alleys)
Warm candlelight or firelight; avoid mystical ritual props (candles, incense)
Brown/earthy, grungy palettes that detract from high-key white purity

style_overrides.color_palette: High-key whites, cool grays, subtle iridescent crystal highlights
style_overrides.materials: Polished matte white composites, clear/crystal elements, minimal metal
style_overrides.lighting: Pure white core eruption with exposure blowout and soft cinematic bloom; sharp mechanical snap cue
style_overrides.architecture: Non-descript abstract futurist forms; no identifiable cultural motifs or signage
style_overrides.camera_style: Front-facing hero close-up, shallow depth-of-field, blurred background
style_overrides.props: White intricate activation device with twin crystal wings (crystal/mechanical aesthetic)
style_overrides.wardrobe: Modern-futurist jacket; no logos, patches, or military insignia
style_overrides.vfx: Clean geometric light behaviors; no glyphs, runes, smoke, or particle clutter
style_overrides.ui_elements: Avoid textual HUD; if needed, use minimal geometric overlays only
style_overrides.environment: Indeterminate interior or staging area implied; maintain abstraction

project_settings.era_lock: Unspecified far-future sci-fi era (NOT contemporary or historical)

key_events: Young man fixes a resolute gaze toward camera.
He draws a white, intricate device from his jacket.
Twin crystal wings snap open with a sharp mechanical sound.
Pure white light erupts from the center crystal, blowing out exposure.
The light swallows the entire frame into blinding white.
narrative_context.cultural_context: Techno-mystical transformation imagery emphasizing heroic resolve and ritualized activation of advanced technology.

characters.name: Determined Young Man
characters.description: Young man in a red-and-white sci-fi uniform with intense, resolute gaze; stands firm, ready to act.
characters.clothing_style: Red-and-white sci-fi uniform; fitted jacket with concealed pocket for device.
characters.personality: Focused, courageous, resolute; committed to activating the device.
characters.backstory: Not revealed in excerpt; carries a specialized device suggesting crucial purpose.
characters.current_motivation: Trigger the device’s transformation/light effect with unwavering resolve.
